# Blast radius is the hypothesis

`customer_support.mm.root_cause_analysis.blast_radius_is_the_hypothesis` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Who is affected and who is not is itself the hypothesis. The population outline is the cause outline, drawn before any log is opened.

Population evidence is cheap, already collected, and constrains the search far more sharply than any single deep trace. Teams skip it because deep investigation feels like the real work.
